name: Puerto Rico (US)
headline: Puerto Rico (US): +0.3% growth in 2025, 1.5% inflation, debt 18% of GDP
sections: Puerto Rico (US) is a $129 billion economy (2025), the world's 67th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +0.3% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $52K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 44.0% of GDP (2025).

Consumer prices rose 1.5% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 6.0% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 5.6% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 14.0% (2025).
Gross government debt is 18% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 50% in 2020. The general government balance is −0.4% of GDP (2025).
Trade equals 90% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy.
IMF projections put government debt at 18% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 81.9 years (2024). Population: 3.2 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
